frozen_comparison.scope: three training seeds reported individually; four starts are not independent training seeds

checkpoint_latent_std.scope: CPU read-only checkpoint exploration scale; latent pre-tanh units, not joint radians

conventions.duration: Per-seed means of four fixed first episodes; mean and sample SD across three training seeds.
conventions.tracking: Arithmetic mean of four per-start RMSE/tilt values over the initial/final common survival window; body RMSE in meters.
conventions.tail: p99 over the maximum absolute joint speed per environment substep; estimated PD torque is not solver-measured torque.
conventions.windows: Full first-episode tails are reported separately from common-window initial/final tails.
conventions.scope: Static reference, four prescribed starts, three seeds and one fixed noise tape per seed; no formal benchmark or generalization claim.
conventions.timeout: A configured 10-second horizon does not validate the physical timeout branch when all episodes terminate early.
